question: A rectangular sheet of paper with dimensions 44 cm by 10 cm is rolled into a right circular cylinder with the 10 cm side becoming the height. What is the approximate volume of the cylinder?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of sheet = 44 cm

Height of cylinder = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of base = 2 × π × r

Volume of cylinder = π × r² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r = 44

⇒ (44 ÷ 7) × r = 44

⇒ r = 7

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 7² × 10

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 49 × 10

⇒ Volume = 22 × 7 × 10

⇒ Volume = 1540

**∴ The correct answer is 1540.**
